Foundation Panel 的功能更新，随 Foundation Sunshine 安装包一起提供。
A feature update of the Foundation Panel, shipped with the Foundation Sunshine installer.

- 全新的反馈面板：标题栏图标、右键菜单、托盘「反馈问题…」和崩溃恢复后的提示都打开同一个面板，日志随反馈发送，可留联系方式。
  A new feedback panel: the title-bar icon, the context menu, the tray's "Report a problem…" and the prompt after a crash recovery all open the same panel; the log goes with the report and a contact can be left.
- 全新的首次运行引导：更新通道成为独立一步，完成页提供可选设置和高级入口。
  A new first-run guide: the update channel is a step of its own, and the finish page offers optional settings and advanced entries.
- 更新下载进度条改为 Material 3 Expressive 的波浪进度，修复等待状态下波浪被直线横穿、进度大幅跳变时画面突变的问题。
  The update download bar is now the Material 3 Expressive wavy progress; fixes a straight line crossing the wave while waiting and abrupt redraws when the progress jumps.
- 修复概览磁贴在大窗口里的版式问题（滑块、串流时长、海报被裁、空档），空位由更多标准大小的磁贴补上。
  Fixes layout problems of the overview tiles in large windows (sliders, stream time, cropped posters, gaps); empty spots are filled with more standard-size tiles.
- 隐私说明如实写明：关闭匿名使用统计或问题自动上报时，会发送一条「已关闭」记录。
  The privacy text now states that turning off anonymous usage statistics or automatic problem reports sends one "turned off" record.

本发行版的 `sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` 供 Foundation Sunshine 打包使用；单独使用请安装 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest)。
`sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` in this release is used by Foundation Sunshine's packaging; to use the panel, install [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest).
